purpose: Provide one machine-oriented restart entrypoint for the complete FPT Portal V2 website/Admin system, including a simplified Student Login Manager batch-creation flow with required D1 timestamps and precise duplicate classification, while preserving Replace Resource and shared-Worker quiz-bridge authorities.

base.role: base business invariants, topology, preservation ledger, open gates, stop conditions and historical reconciliation

replaceResourceOverride.role: higher authority for Replace Resource canonical-to-prepared consistency plus its CORS-preflight repair state

quizBridgeCompositionOverride.role: higher authority for the shared fpt-portal-v2-worker top-level composition and quiz redeem-route preservation

adminBatchCreationOverride.role: higher authority for simple Admin batch creation, required batch timestamps, precise duplicate classification and refresh/selection before ordinary student provisioning

fullSiteWorkflow.role: website-wide execution map; scope-specific overrides supersede conflicting statements within their declared scope

restartInstruction: Read the complete authority set above before diagnosing or changing Portal/Admin behaviour. Freshly prove live route/deployment/data-store ownership. Preserve every shared Worker capability. Fail closed when state, projection parity, live ownership or rollback safety cannot be proved. Update this manifest and the applicable authority file in the same coherent change whenever authority or workflow behaviour changes.

latestRepositoryChange.name: Simplified Admin batch creation
latestRepositoryChange.implementation: worker/src/admin-batch-manager-v2.js remains routed by worker/src/index-admin-tools.js for batch creation; ordinary student provisioning remains in worker/src/admin-student-manager.js.
latestRepositoryChange.rootCauseFixed: The original false BATCH_ALREADY_EXISTS result came from omitted created_at/updated_at values combined with an over-broad SQL constraint classifier.
latestRepositoryChange.createHardening: New batch creation supplies required created_at/updated_at fields, requires the selected template to be active on activeFrom, and maps only a true batch_key UNIQUE/primary-key collision to BATCH_ALREADY_EXISTS.
latestRepositoryChange.uiSimplification: Student Login Manager exposes only the simple flow: create batch, refresh/select it automatically, then press Create Student Login. The separate Reactivate action was removed from the Admin surface.
latestRepositoryChange.uiPresentationHardening: Copy settings from options retain visible whitespace between batch code and human-readable description.
latestRepositoryChange.importantBoundary: Creating a batch does not create a student. Create Student Login remains a separate deliberate action.

latestClosedRepair.name: Shared Worker quiz bridge composition restoration
latestClosedRepair.permanentInvariant: The shared production Worker must retain the composed index-step10-quiz-bridge.js -> index-admin-tools.js chain.

websiteWorkflowCoverage: lesson release import and prepared access publication
Admin creation of new batch definitions from existing batch settings
precise duplicate-key classification and active-list refresh/selection
shared Worker deployment preservation and regression verification
nonNegotiableCompletionRule: No student-visible Admin/source mutation is complete merely because its canonical source write succeeded. Creating a batch is distinct from creating a student login. A generic SQL constraint failure must never be presented as a duplicate batch, and Student Login Manager must not silently overwrite or reactivate an existing batch key.
nextChangeProtocol: record evidence and update GCH authority
